known_issues.summary: On macOS 27.0.1, Apple's APFS resize has failed for another owner with error -69606 despite clean First Aid. If it fails here, nothing is installed and macOS stays as it was; going back to macOS 26 helped that owner.

evidence.claim: Sekka boots on the reference J514S through Asahi's m1n1 stage 1 v1.6.1, m1n1 v1.6.1-omarchy.aurora17, U-Boot 2026.07 and linux-aurora 7.1.12-aurora20.
evidence.source: The device tree's chosen node and uname on the reference J514S (Mac15,6, apple,j514s apple,t6030), read from Linux.

evidence.claim: That boot ran on system firmware mBoot-20457.1.29 (the macOS 27.0 system firmware) with the OS firmware its drivers see as 14.7, which Asahi's installer supplies as 14.8.3.
evidence.source: asahi,iboot1-version, asahi,system-fw-version and asahi,os-fw-version in the device tree's chosen node on the reference J514S.

evidence.claim: Aizome runs as the desktop session on the reference J514S, with the panel's backlight controlled by Sekka's T6030 backlight patch.
evidence.source: The running session on the reference J514S; DEVELOPERS.md, T6030 developer-image brightness.

evidence.claim: The built-in panel runs natively at 3024x1964 and 120 Hz, the GPU draws the desktop, and a 4K display works over one USB-C port (atc0).
Not working in that report: the second USB-C port, sleep with a display attached, and GPU clocks above 1056 MHz.
A fresh installation through Sekka Installer, its Recovery app and first-boot setup reaches Aizome's login screen.
On the original developer installation, Wi-Fi (wld0) is up, Bluetooth (hci0), the keyboard and trackpad (Apple MTP) and the panel backlight are present, and speakersafetyd is running.
evidence.source: ip link, /sys/class/bluetooth, /proc/bus/input/devices, /sys/class/backlight and systemctl on the reference J514S.

evidence.claim: The same devices work on a fresh installation, with the firmware that installation extracts, and sound plays through speakersafetyd.
